analysis.exploratory: everything else (fixed-recipe arm, diagnostics, cost correlations, historical results) is labelled exploratory
analysis.multiplicity: primary comparison alone at alpha; Holm over the secondary family within each stage
analysis.paired_rule: paired t-interval when every compared seed has identical backbone-initialisation checksums and the keyed data plan was verified identical; otherwise Welch
analysis.primary_comparison: apu vs apu_frozen, equal-search arm, stage 1; repeated as the confirmation test in stage 2
analysis.primary_outcome: final-epoch test top-1 of the final-epoch checkpoint (checkpoint rule fixed in advance)
secondary_family: apu vs strongest validated standard (relu, gelu)
apu vs strongest validated adaptive (prelu, acon_c)
analysis.seeds: fixed in advance; no seeds are added based on significance
analysis.strongest_rule: highest mean final validation top-1 among the final fits of that group (validation only)

decision_rules.A: Full adaptation exceeds the frozen profile and the strongest validated standard and adaptive baselines in both shallow datasets -> evidence for learned power adaptation in these tested shallow settings, with stated uncertainty and measured costs.
decision_rules.B: Full and frozen profiles perform similarly -> a useful fixed profile may explain any gain; learning has not demonstrated additional value.
decision_rules.C: Benefit appears only on CIFAR-10 -> a restricted exploratory observation requiring further confirmation.
decision_rules.D: Accuracy improves but runtime increases -> an accuracy and computation trade-off, not general efficiency.
decision_rules.E: No reproducible advantage over strong controls -> revise the central claim or pursue a carefully supported behavioural analysis.

depth_study.hyperparameters: stage-1 selected configuration of each method

pade.search: same grid, selection seeds and epochs as stage 1

extensions.trigger: decision A, or FORCE_EXTENSIONS (then labelled exploratory)

first_passage.censoring: runs that never reach it stay visible as censored
first_passage.threshold_rule: 0.95 x mean final validation top-1 of relu in the same arm and setting

question: Does learning a bounded input-dependent power improve shallow image classification over a matched frozen profile and competitive learned activations, under equal validation and training budgets, and at what computational cost?

search.budget: identical grid, selection seeds and epochs for every method, including the frozen control
search.criterion: mean final-epoch validation top-1 over the selection seeds
search.failed_candidate: a candidate with any failed selection seed is not selectable
search.tie_break: earlier candidate in grid order (grid[0] is the historical recipe)

stage2.role: predeclared confirmation of the selected protocol (no new selection)
